Perhaps you meant, "Government handouts?" It seems to me that charity, if exercised as a free choice by knowledgeable people, is a zero-sum issue. I give my money to someone who needs help. I lose that money, but it's mine to give. If I suffer no ill consequences, and I have the wisdom to restrict my giving to the actually needy, I'm merely helping someone else become a productive member of society, or if not, I'm helping someone who is truly helpless, and that's my choice.

Even completely voluntary charity causes a whole host of issues. E.g. food aid and donated second hand clothing have devastated the garment industries and agriculture in Africa. It's one of those things that feels laudable and has really negative side effects. :(
